name: bgwriter_lru_maxpages
description: Maximum number of dirty buffers the background writer flushes to disk per LRU scan round.
symptoms: Spike in backend write I/O during checkpoints
Buffer allocation stalls under heavy write load
tuning_tips: Increase gradually (e.g., by 50–100) if dirty buffers consistently exceed 80% of shared_buffers; reduce if background writer competes with backends for I/O bandwidth. Set to 0 only to disable LRU flushing entirely.
